theme: Protect income. Care for home. Build our way forward.
northStar: Keep the next few days obvious, the next couple of weeks easy to scan, and the longer direction available without making it dominate daily life.
workNorthStar: Protect dependable income while replacing lower-leverage hours with better work and repeatable 3DVR revenue, without letting the business consume home and family life.
operatingRule: Today first. Then the next few days. Protect recovery and home time before filling open space with more work.
workOperatingRule: Protect booked income, use open blocks for the highest-leverage work, and keep home/family commitments visible as real commitments.

today.title: Work day
today.sharedDetail: Full work day in the middle of a dense stretch. Keep tonight mostly clear and recover for Friday.
today.detail: Protect booked income and keep outside work asynchronous after the shift.

nextDays.title: Work day + personal appointment
nextDays.when: Fri · 7:30 AM–1:45 PM · appointment at 3 PM
nextDays.sharedDetail: Work ends before the personal appointment. Keep the transition buffer protected.
nextDays.detail: Leave enough travel/reset time between commitments.

nextDays.title: Work day + family event
nextDays.when: Sat · 6 AM–5 PM · family event afterward
nextDays.sharedDetail: Long work day followed by a family commitment. Expect very little spare energy.
nextDays.detail: Protect the family event and avoid adding business work afterward.

nextDays.title: Work day
nextDays.sharedDetail: Another booked day. Keep the evening light before Monday's long shift.

next30.title: Protect energy through the dense work run
next30.label: Sep 24–Oct 1
next30.sharedDetail: The calendar stays heavily booked through Oct 1. Keep evenings light, protect sleep and family time, and avoid turning every gap into more work.
next30.detail: Let automation and asynchronous systems carry routine business activity while booked work protects income.

next30.title: Protect the first open stretch
next30.label: Oct 2–4
next30.sharedDetail: After the dense work run, keep the first open stretch intentionally lighter and available for personal commitments, home, family, and recovery.
next30.detail: Only add bounded high-leverage work after recovery needs are covered.

next30.title: Make income less fragile
next30.label: By mid-Oct
next30.sharedDetail: Keep dependable work while building at least one more repeatable source of income.
next30.detail: Pursue another paying client or recurring opportunity and higher-value freelance work.

next90.title: More control over the schedule
next90.label: October
next90.sharedDetail: Create fewer chaotic weeks and more choice over which work Thomas says yes to.
next90.detail: Replace weaker work selectively while keeping the financial floor intact.

next90.title: More predictable independent income
next90.label: November–December
next90.sharedDetail: Shift some income toward recurring work so every month does not start from zero.
next90.detail: Scale the service/channel that actually produces legitimate revenue with low support burden.
